Row.Text: Modern China
Modern China
Mao Zedong
A single spark can start a prairie fire.

From a small boat on the lake to the tower above the square, the people of this land covered in decades what others took centuries to walk. The lights of the Congress never go out, the slogans of the Work Focus are painted across factories and fields, and the banner of the Red Army is planted on the peaks. A new China is being forged again.
Qian Xuesen
My career is in China, my achievements are in China, and my home is China.

From aerodynamics to systems engineering, Qian Xuesen organized science into national capability. He saw the turning points of history not merely as gifts of fortune, but as opportunities to turn every possibility into an engineering program.
Hu Jintao
Scientific development takes development as its essence, puts people first, requires comprehensive, balanced and sustainable development, and follows a holistic approach.

He widened the measure of development beyond a single growth figure to the balance among people, society, and nature. The neighborhood becomes the city's common room, joining culture, recreation, and knowledge on one street; each improvement supports its neighbors, and modernization returns to human life.

Eurekas and Inspirations provide an additional 10% of Science and Culture. Clearing a Barbarian Camp, establishing a Trade Route, or gaining a city on a different continent from your original Capital grants one random Eureka or Inspiration from your current era or earlier. If that Eureka or Inspiration was already triggered, the Technology or Civic is unlocked directly.
Rebuild China

Your Holy Sites and Congress districts provide large adjacency bonuses and take half the time to build. Each time you adopt a government for the first time, gain 1 Governor title. Cities with a Governor produce double Production and Culture. You have the unique Governor Zhu.
Strategic Scientist

When you enter a Golden Age, gain all Eurekas for the current era; when you enter a Dark Age, gain all Inspirations for the current era; when you enter a Heroic Age, gain both. Each of your Campuses provides +1 Great Artist point and +1 Great Musician point. Each of your Libraries provides 2 Great Work of Writing slots. Your improved Strategic Resources provide +1 Culture and +1 Faith. After unlocking Chemistry, unlock Nuclear Fission and Combined Arms; after unlocking Computers, unlock Nuclear Fusion.
Scientific Outlook on Development

Your Neighborhoods are unlocked by Recorded History, and cities with a functioning Neighborhood are always fully loyal. Neighborhoods can construct the buildings of both the Entertainment Complex and the Theater Square. Gain 1 Builder whenever a Congress is completed. An improved tile with at least one adjacent improved tile gains +1 Food, +1 Production, +1 Gold, +1 Science, +1 Culture and +1 Faith.

A Modern China unique district that only Modern China can build, replacing its Government Plaza; every other civilization keeps the standard Government Plaza. Unlocked by State Workforce. Your civilization has no empire-wide limit on Congress districts, but each city may contain one. Every Congress after your civilization's first cannot hold buildings, grants no Governor title when completed, and does not count against the district capacity limit. A city with a Congress unlocks the Work Focus projects.

Hu Jintao's unique Neighborhood, replacing the standard Neighborhood. It is unlocked by Recorded History instead of Urbanization and can construct the buildings of both the Entertainment Complex and the Theater Square. Cities with a functioning Neighborhood are always fully loyal.
Red Army

A unique Industrial era melee unit that replaces the Line Infantry, unlocked by The Enlightenment. 4 Movement (faster than the Line Infantry). It has 1 build charge and can build a Mountain Tunnel on an adjacent Mountain tile, allowing any unit to cross that Mountain. +2 Combat Strength for each Strategic Resource you own, and +1 Combat Strength for each adjacent friendly unit.
Mountain Tunnel
This unit has 1 build charge and can build a Mountain Tunnel on an adjacent Mountain tile.
Mechanics Class

Qian Xuesen's unique building, replacing the Research Lab and unlocked by Industrialization. +5 Science. When fully powered, +10 additional Science. +1 Citizen slot and +2 Great Scientist points per turn. Provides Culture equal to the Campus's Science adjacency bonus.
A building available to Hu Jintao and constructible in a Neighborhood district.
+2 Faith for each adjacent district
+2 Production for each adjacent district
+2 Culture for each adjacent district
Work Focus: Economic Development
Lasts 20 turns. +15% Gold and Food in this city. While active, each district and building completed in this city grants +1 Trade Route capacity.
Work Focus: Spiritual Civilization
Lasts 20 turns. +15% Culture and Faith in this city. While active, each completed project has a chance to grant a Great Work of Art.
Work Focus: Scientific Innovation
Lasts 10 turns. +30% Science and Production in this city. Each non-civilian unit produced in this city grants Great Person points equal to 20% of its cost.
Marshal of the Red Army
Mao's unique Governor (3 turns to establish). Military line on the left, economic line on the right.
Red Army Rendezvous
When first established in this city, gain a Red Army unit.
Guerrilla Behind the Lines
Military units trained in this city gain +1 Movement.
Base Area Economy
Builders trained in this city gain +1 build charge and +1 Movement.
Army and People Together
Military units can be purchased with Faith in this city.
Military Industry
This city's Encampment provides +1 Production for each adjacent district. +50% Production toward Encampments, Industrial Zones and their buildings in this city.
Mixed Economy
This city provides +2 Gold, +2 Food and +2 Production for each of its districts.
+1 Production for each adjacent district
Guerrilla Mobility
Trained in a city with the Guerrilla Behind the Lines promotion: +1 Movement.
Base Area Builders
Trained in a city with the Base Area Economy promotion: +1 Movement.
